purpose: Close Interactive Brokers Rust adapter parity gaps by binding each inventory gap to fixture evidence, an explicit scope decision, or the later removal gate.

decisions.decision: Compact fixture coverage now maps Interactive Brokers instrument, market data, historical, execution, account, and gateway lifecycle surfaces to Rust evidence.
decisions.release_gate_note: Interactive Brokers fixture traceability is no longer open for the R5 adapter parity gate.

decisions.decision: Interactive Brokers requires external TWS/IB Gateway state, UTC timestamp configuration, and env-gated live smoke; zero-config Rust adapter claims are out of scope.
decisions.release_gate_note: Release notes and examples must keep gateway, credentials, and UTC prerequisites explicit.

decisions.decision: IB product-family support is broad and fixture-classified, but unsupported or filtered security types remain explicit scope boundaries.
decisions.release_gate_note: Rust product claims may list supported IB product families only with the documented security-type constraints.

decisions.decision: IB market-data support stays bound to IB API semantics: quote, trade, bar, L1/L2 depth, index, and option-greek paths are supported with the fixture-pinned rejection boundaries.
decisions.release_gate_note: Release evidence must not imply generic L3 MBO, all-security-type greeks, or CurrencyPair trade support.

decisions.decision: Historical bars, ticks, instruments, and duration segmentation remain supported with IB-specific bar-size, tick-type, pacing, and request-parameter limits.
decisions.release_gate_note: Release evidence must keep supported bar sizes, tick types, and request boundary behavior explicit.

decisions.decision: Execution submit, modify, cancel, order-list, fill, and spread handling paths are supported with explicit order-shape and rejection constraints.
decisions.release_gate_note: Release evidence must not claim unsupported post-only, non-inverse quote-quantity, non-price trailing offset, unsupported side, or cancel-all side-filter behavior.

decisions.decision: Account summary, PnL, position, reconnect, and gateway lifecycle behavior remains live-operation dependent, with static fixture evidence and env-gated smoke as the release boundary.
decisions.release_gate_note: Routine automation must use fixture, mock, dry-run, or env-gated live smoke evidence instead of requiring real IB credentials.

decisions.decision: Optional Interactive Brokers Python/PyO3 bridge surfaces are not removed by this adapter parity task.
decisions.release_gate_note: Removal remains blocked until the dedicated Rust-only removal gate approves Python/PyO3 deletion.
